findings.claim: The export reads the kind name as kinds_by_code.get(code).name, but a confirmed document can carry a druh code that no longer exists in the catalogue (DELETE, PUT code change and apply-template replace only check to_review documents), so .get returns None and the whole ZIP export fails with a 500.
findings.fix: Take the folder name from fields_meta.druh_dokladu.kind_name (stored at determination time) with kinds_by_code only as a fallback; handle a missing code explicitly (folder <code>_ and a _navod.txt warning); add a test that exports a reviewed document whose kind was deleted or replaced by a template.

findings.claim: A document approved through review-and-archive ends up archived with tax_profile_state 'proposed', so it always lands in _NEIMPORTOVAT/k_rucnimu_posouzeni, while PATCH /tax-profile returns 422 for archived documents; the plan gives the user no way in the UI to confirm it (only the one-off backfill --confirm-approved, run once after deployment).
findings.fix: Say what happens to documents archived through the shortcut after deployment: either the shortcut confirms the proposals (with expected_* fields), or the shortcut is refused for documents with an unconfirmed profile/kind, or the tax-profile PATCH is allowed on archived documents. Name the test for the chosen path.

findings.claim: apply-template add_missing and the automatic is_default for the first kind of a direction are check-then-insert; two concurrent calls hit the unique (client_id, code) or the partial is_default index, and the plan only maps the is_default collision to 409 and describes idempotence only for sequential calls.
findings.command: grep -n "existuje kód → \`skipped\`\|partial unique index odmítne\|při druhém volání" .aid-o/work/evidence/P998/cp1/round-1/packet/plan.md
findings.fix: Use INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING (count those rows as skipped) or lock per client, and state that a concurrent apply-template returns 200/409, never 500.
